title: A credential list qualified by a word outside the fixed credential list (service, Slack, private tokens, units, points) or a credential noun in the question with the unit list in an option is classed design
goal: class_reasons in _tools/bl_authority.py keeps the secrets class for a unit-noun list whose tokens carry a credential qualifier (service tokens, Slack tokens, private tokens, API with two spaces or a possessive) and for a question that names a credential owner (the API) beside an option that starts with tokens, while a plain unit-noun list stays design (SP-hlt2tdel review gap 3 and the orchestrator's cross-join probe, BG-t6xrawba)

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import bl_authority as a;c=lambda q,o=['a','b']:a.class_reasons({'touches':[]},{'question':q,'options':o})[0];ok=all(c(q)=='secrets' for q in ['Print service tokens, units, points','Should the worker print Slack tokens, rows, lines to the log?','Print private tokens, rows, lines']) and c('Which counts does the cost line name for the API',['tokens, units, points','units only'])=='secrets';sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)

notes: Evidence 2026-10-15 (ST-v7d2dc2x gate g2): a provisional gate whose option lists the json field names input_tokens, output_tokens, cache_write_tokens and cache_read_tokens (LLM token counts, no credential) was classed secrets (matched 'token') and made blocking.
